reference_prompt: Fictional adult main cook with curly dark hair, cream T-shirt, pickle-green apron, warm kitchen, blank cream phone display.

params.prompt:
Photorealistic premium food-comedy commercial, vertical 9:16, energetic editorial rhythm, warm cream and natural kitchen light, realistic faces and anatomically correct hands. The unusual recipe is a transparent bright yellow scalloped ring of savory vegetable gelatin containing celery, green bell pepper and chopped onion, with a central hole; preserve the dish shown in the food reference. No writing, captions, logos, watermarks, app UI, graphic overlays or music: those will be composited later. Natural action sound effects only. Shots must be clear, physical actions, not a slideshow. CHARACTER AND LOCATION: image 1 is the exact fictional lead actor and kitchen reference. Preserve her face, curly dark tied-back hair, cream T-shirt, pickle-green apron and warm oak-and-cream kitchen across all shots. Image 2 is the dish reference only, not a background.
SIX-SECOND OPENING, four purposeful shots with clean cuts:
0.0–2.0s: tight over-the-shoulder insert of her hand holding an upright black smartphone, display uniformly cream with no markings. Her right thumb makes ONE decisive horizontal left-to-right slider gesture across the lower screen, reaching the far-right end. The physical phone is stable and its rectangular screen unobscured apart from the thumb.
2.0–3.0s: slightly wider over-the-shoulder view as she holds the phone still and studies the blank cream display. A tiny upbeat notification chime.
3.0–4.8s: cut to her actual face, clear cinematic close-up. She raises an eyebrow and gives a slow, mischievous closed-mouth grin, visibly deciding to make this ridiculous dish. Do not replace this with a shot of food.
4.8–6.0s: hard cut overhead to her counter with celery, a green bell pepper, an onion and a small clear bowl of yellow gelatin mixture arranged as ingredients. Her green-apron torso is visible at the frame edge. Quick purposeful movement into preparing them.
Camera energy: short punch-in, clean whip-matched cuts, expressive human performance. No typing. No spoken dialogue.

Show their faces and hand actions, not only finished food. Different kitchens, different home plates, same recognizable recipe.

Each person lifts or aims a black smartphone at their own dish and photographs it. Distinct white, pale blue and patterned plates make the attempts individual. No readable phone screens, no speech claims, no logos, no numbers or captions. No main cook in these panels. No extra fingers or fused people.
